create_ImageEncodingStage: create an ImageEncodingStage to encode image prompts into embeddings for diffusion models
build_LTX2ImageEncodingStage: build an LTX2ImageEncodingStage to encode image paths into packed token latents for LTX-2 TI2V pipelines
create_ImageVAEEncodingStage: create an ImageVAEEncodingStage to encode pixel representations into latent space using a ParallelTiledVAE
run_VAE_encode: run VAE encoding on video condition tensors with configurable sample mode and tiling support
test_verify_input: test the verify_input method of ImageVAEEncodingStage to validate batch generator, height, width, and num_frames
